prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square opaque ground material texture for an original 2D tactical forest game. Orthographic overhead camera, painterly semi-realistic fantasy strategy map art. Entire image is only a reusable surface material, no scene layout, no border, no horizon, no perspective, no tile grid, no cast shadows, no trees, large rocks, characters, props, UI, text or watermark. Even soft diffuse daylight and subdued natural colors. Fine-scale details should remain readable when used on 92-unit game tiles. Edge-to-edge natural variation with no conspicuous repeating motifs or strong center feature. Primary request: compact bare earth, warm gray-brown and muted sandy ochre soil, finely granular dry loam, a few very small weathered pebbles and subtle shallow worn patches. NO grass, moss, leaves, plants or roots; it must clearly read as easy-to-traverse exposed soil. Moderate low contrast, restrained smooth broad tonal variation. Not orange desert sand, cracked wasteland, mud or stone pavement.
